name: Brand Gradient
note: Sky to indigo to violet, front and center.
thesis: The brand gradient leads everything: a washed sky→indigo→violet field behind frosted-glass panes, with luminous gradient accents on every interactive primitive — tasteful and airy, never garish.

tokens.bg: Layered radial washes (sky #7dd3fc top-left, violet #c4b5fd top-right, indigo #818cf8 bottom) over a near-white #f7f8fe canvas, plus a slow-drifting blurred aurora blob layer.
tokens.fg: Deep indigo-ink #1e1b3a primary, #4a4870 secondary, #807da6 muted — warmer than pure zinc to sit inside the wash.
tokens.accent: indigo-600 #4f46e5 for interaction; violet-600 #7c3aed for eyebrows/emphasis; the deep gradient linear-gradient(120deg, #38bdf8, #6366f1 52%, #8b5cf6) for fills.
tokens.fontDisplay: Geist (var(--font-display)) at 600 weight, tight tracking (-0.03em) for big display lines.
tokens.fontMono: Geist Mono (var(--font-mono)) for eyebrows, numerals, table headers, meta.
tokens.radius: Soft and generous — 11px controls, 18px cards, 26px hero/contact panels, full-pill buttons/tabs/badges.
tokens.border: Indigo-tinted hairlines rgba(99,102,241,0.14→0.24) plus a 1px inner white highlight (var glow) so glass reads as a lit pane.
tokens.motion: Gentle ease-out lifts on hover (translateY -3px), drifting aurora (22s) and a discipline marquee (30s); all animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

layout: Single centered column, max-width ~1140px, on a full-bleed gradient field with a drifting aurora layer behind. A centered hero (pill → display headline with one gradient-clipped phrase → lede → CTA pair → 4-up figures band in glass) opens it, followed by a full-width discipline marquee. Below, left-eyebrowed sections stack with generous rhythm: a 2-col selected-work grid of frosted cards with gradient thumbnails, pill-tab capabilities (services grid / process timeline / FAQ accordion), a 2-col about + impact-charts split, a 4-up team grid, a testimonials carousel, a recognition table beside a clients/press rail, and a large glassy contact panel (budget MoodMeter + ReasonTag on the left, a brief Composer form with Slider/Switch/Progress on the right). Glass cards (translucent fill + backdrop-blur + inner highlight) float over the wash everywhere.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Centered studio pitch: glass status pill, large display headline with one phrase gradient-text-clipped, lede, gradient + glass CTA buttons, and a 4-up figures band in a glass card.
sections.restyle: Headline phrase uses .brand-gradient-text (background-clip:text). Primary Button is a pill filled with the deep gradient + colored glow shadow; secondary is frosted glass with indigo text. Figures band is a backdrop-blurred glass pane; numerals are gradient-clipped.

sections.name: marquee
sections.what: Edge-faded auto-scrolling band of disciplines with gradient dots.
sections.restyle: Pure CSS infinite track masked at both edges; each dot carries the deep gradient. Pauses under prefers-reduced-motion.

sections.name: selected work
sections.what: Filterable 2-col grid of project cards, each with a gradient thumbnail panel, title/year, discipline, blurb, and tag badges; paginated.
sections.restyle: Cards are frosted glass with hover-lift; thumbnails are per-project gradient blends via data-proj. Pillbox input becomes a glass pill; Pagination active page wears the gradient. One stretched <Link> per card (no nested anchors).

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Pill-tab switcher over Services (4 glass cards), Process (timeline), and Questions (accordion).
sections.restyle: Tabs.List is a glass pill rail; the active tab is filled with the gradient + glow. Timeline dot colors run sky→indigo→violet→fuchsia; accordion items are individual glass panes.

sections.name: about + impact
sections.what: Left: lead statement + body + a gradient Callout. Right: a glass metrics card with a filled line chart and a horizontal bar chart.
sections.restyle: Callout fill is a soft sky→violet wash. Charts use gradient-stop colors (#7dd3fc/#818cf8/#a78bfa/#c4b5fd). Separator is a fading gradient hairline.

sections.name: team
sections.what: 4-up grid of member cards with glowing avatars.
sections.restyle: Avatars use glow ring; cards are frosted glass with hover-lift.

sections.name: testimonials
sections.what: Looping carousel of client quotes with star rating and attribution.
sections.restyle: Slides are glass panels; controls are glass pills; active step dots wear the gradient. Display-weight quote text with tight tracking.

sections.name: recognition + clients
sections.what: Awards Table beside a rail of client badges and a press list.
sections.restyle: Table is wrapped in a glass card; mono uppercase headers on a faint indigo tint; rows hover indigo. Client badges are outline glass pills.

sections.name: contact / brief
sections.what: Large gradient-glass panel: left a budget MoodMeter + ReasonTag confidence read; right an elevated brief form (Composer + char Progress + timeline Slider + newsletter Switch + send Button) with a success state.
sections.restyle: Panel has corner radial gradient washes over strong glass. MoodMeter uses indigo/violet handles; Progress, Slider fill, and Switch on-state all wear the deep gradient; Send button is the gradient pill.

palette.restyle: Full pill. Primary = deep gradient fill (sky→indigo→violet) + white text + colored glow shadow + hover lift; secondary = frosted glass + indigo text + violet on hover.
Pill radius, weight 600. Soft variants tint indigo/violet/emerald; outline variants are glass with indigo-tinted hairlines.
Frosted glass: translucent white fill + backdrop-blur + indigo hairline + inner white highlight; hover lifts 3px into a violet-tinted shadow. The contact panel adds corner radial gradient washes.
List is a glass pill rail; active tab is gradient-filled with a glow, inactive tabs are muted ink text.
Wrapped in a glass card; mono uppercase headers on a faint indigo tint, gradient-free hairline rows that hover to a light indigo wash.
Line + horizontal-bar use the gradient stops as series colors; filled line area at low opacity so data reads as colored light.
Indigo (#6366f1) user handle, violet (#a78bfa) posted-ghost handle, on a soft-radius pad sitting inside the glass contact panel.
White inner surface with a glass-pill border that lights to an indigo ring on focus.
All fills and on-states wear the deep gradient; Slider thumb gets an indigo ring + glow.
Input becomes a glass pill; chips tint indigo-soft.
Soft sky→violet linear wash fill with a violet icon, indigo hairline.
Glow ring on team members; plain on attributions.
Timeline dots gradient-laddered; accordion items become individual glass panes; separators are fading gradient hairlines.

contentArchetype: A boutique design/dev studio (FIELDWORK) one-page portfolio: a luminous pitch hero, filterable selected work, tabbed capabilities, a warm about + momentum metrics, the team, client testimonials, awards + clients, and an interactive 'brief the studio' contact panel. Also fits any modern SaaS landing, agency, product-launch, or personal portfolio that wants an optimistic, premium, light-and-airy feel.
remix: Keep the gradient confined to fills, accents, and one display phrase — let frosted glass + deep indigo ink carry the structure so it stays tasteful. To re-skin: change only the three gradient stops (and the per-thumbnail blends) and the whole identity shifts (sunset, aurora-green, mono-violet). Blend toward Swiss/minimal by dialing glass opacity toward solid white, flattening radii, and demoting the gradient to a single hero accent + the logo mark; blend toward a dark style by inverting the canvas to deep slate, raising glass opacity, and brightening the gradient stops. Drop the aurora + marquee first if you need a calmer, more corporate register.
